verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Bitbucket lets teams 'enforce code quality policies and compliance requirements across the organization with standardized, customizable merge checks' and enforce branch permissions, CI/CD policies, and change management workflows. This directly matches the devops-lead story. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of merge-check configuration in practice, and no detail on granularity of specific check types (e.g., required builds, approvals count).
